For each qualifying compound, return the ChEMBL compound identifier (pref_name) and the canonical SMILES representation. The result set should list each compound once, showing its ChEMBL ID and corresponding SMILES.
sql: WITH human_assays AS ( SELECT a.assay_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' ) SELECT DISTINCT md.molecule_chembl_id AS chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM human_assays ha JOIN activities a ON ha.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5514' AND cs.molregno IS NOT NULL;
